artworks.title: Charles-Maurice Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a person sitting slightly to the side, with their head facing forward. The person has mid-length wavy hair, bangs, a prominent nose, and closed lips. They are wearing a formal dark robe with a wide white collar and decorative elements. The background is textured, and the portrait is framed in an ornate rectangular frame. Below the portrait is a heraldic crest with a crown atop a shield with five stars and intricate designs.

artworks.title: Jean Loret
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait from the chest up, seated in an oval frame. He is facing slightly to his right with his gaze toward the viewer. The man has a pointed mustache, shadowed face, long wavy hair, and is wearing a cap. He is dressed in 17th-century-style attire with a textured coat, lace collar, and visible inner garment. The background has horizontal lines within and around the oval frame. The frame is set on a rectangular pedestal with engraved text.

artworks.title: The Doge's Palace
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the water of buildings and boats in Venice. The Doge's Palace and the Campanile di San Marco stand out against a horizon of buildings. The style is detailed with sketched lines showing movement in the sky and water. The color palette is black and grey. Several gondolas and sailing vessels are seen in the water, with the sails contrasting the buildings. Sketch-like clouds fill the sky.

artworks.title: House Where Whistler Died
artworks.description: The image shows a row of buildings with a clock tower in the distance on the left. The viewpoint is from a street level, with the horizon defined by the tops of buildings and trees. The skyline is dominated by the clock tower, which appears darker. The artwork is done in an etching style with intricate detail and precise lines. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of grey and black. Trees frame the foreground, with pedestrians and smaller buildings adding depth and urban activity to the scene.

artworks.title: New Oxford Street, London
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The scene features various forms of transportation, such as horse-drawn carriages and individuals moving about. The architecture on either side frames the street with detailed facades and a sense of depth. A dense crowd of people in different outfits adds to the historical context. A lamppost stands in the center as a focal point. The drawing uses fine lines and intricate detailing to depict this urban environment.

artworks.title: Tower Bridge, Evening
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside with a maritime scene. The point of view is slightly elevated, providing a view of the river with sailing ships and boats. The horizon is in the middle of the image, with the Tower Bridge in the distance. There are structures emitting smoke that blends with the sky. The artwork uses an etching technique with fine lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is sepia tones, giving it a vintage look. The background shows city structures fading into mist.

artworks.title: The Tobacco Shop
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tobacco shop facade. The image features the exterior of an old-fashioned shop with large glass windows, ornate detailing, and a sign above indicating the sale of tobacco and snuff products for the royal family. The drawing shows detailed architectural features and the storefront. The drawing appears to have a textured quality, possibly created using etching techniques.

artworks.title: The Yorkshire Terrier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the exterior of a shop with multiple bird cages on display. Above the entrance, a sign reads "THE YORKSHIRE TERRIER." The drawing captures an array of birdcages hanging outside the shop. The windows, doors, and other architectural details are sketched meticulously. Some figures are suggested standing near the entrance.

artworks.title: The Founder's Tomb,  Church of Saint Bartholomew the Great
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural feature within a Gothic structure. The focus is on an ornate paneling or screen with detailed tracery and sculptural elements. The design features pointed arches and delicately carved details. Flanking the central element are two large archways, giving a sense of depth and scale. The piece has a textural quality due to the pencil or etching technique used.

artworks.title: London Bridge Stairs
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge crossing a river with buildings lining the banks. The bridge extends from the left-hand side into the distance towards the center. Various buildings with different architectural features line the river banks in the background. The drawing style appears to be an etching, with fine lines creating texture and detail, especially in the architecture. The color scheme consists of sepia and brown tones, giving a warm and nostalgic atmosphere. Boats and small figures are visible near the riverbank on the left, while buildings frame the river on the right. The river flows under the bridge's arch towards the city in the background.

artworks.title: West Door, St. Paul's
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural hall with towering columns. The artwork captures the interior of a vast hall featuring large, imposing columns with a high, intricately detailed ceiling. The drawing conveys a sense of solemnity and grandeur, with a play of light and shadow emphasizing the architectural details. The strokes are soft and impressionistic, suggesting depth and texture, with lighter areas depicting the flow of light through the space. The choice of monochrome gives the drawing a classic and timeless feel.

artworks.title: Whitehall Court
artworks.description: This image shows a river scene with a low vantage point. The horizon features a dark silhouette of a large building with towers and spires. In front of the building, a bridge is visible, with its reflection in the water. The sky is filled with expressive and textured clouds, contrasting with the still water. The color palette is dark, with shades of black and gray, creating a somber atmosphere. Light and shadow play on the water's surface, enhancing the composition.

artworks.title: No. 230 Strand
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with buildings featuring numerous signs. The image depicts a detailed facade of an urban setting with architectural elements that include windows, storefronts, and various advertising signs on the buildings. The signs indicate the presence of a bookshop and other possibly commercial establishments. The drawing captures the texture and details of the building exteriors alongside some vague forms depicting the bustling atmosphere at street level.

artworks.title: Magnificent Kensington
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with detailed architectural features from a slightly elevated point of view. A grand building with a large domed tower and ornate detailing dominates the lower quarter of the composition. Additional structures and trees are visible beyond the main building. The background displays a cloudy sky with soft, expressive lines, and the drawing is rendered in varying shades of black and grey, creating contrast between the architecture and sky. The style is linear with deliberate strokes capturing structural details and adding texture to the clouds and foliage.

artworks.title: Great College Street, Westminster
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with buildings, trees, and people. The scene is depicted in an etching style with fine lines defining the textures. The color palette is monochromatic, creating depth through shading. People are walking along the sidewalk, and more figures can be seen in the distance along with lampposts.

artworks.title: Bridge of San Juan D'Los Reyos, Toledo
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with an arched bridge extending across a chasm. In the background, there is a cathedral-like building and other structures. The artwork is detailed, with fine etching lines depicting textures and architectural features. The color palette consists of sepia tones and shades of brown. Rocks and plants are visible in the foreground, with the bridge and distant structures drawing the viewer's focus.

artworks.title: Arch of Bridge of Alcantara
artworks.description: The image features an arched bridge extending towards a fortified tower on the left side. The composition is dominated by the bridge, structures, and landscape. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of sepia and brown. In the background, there are buildings, landscape elements, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Puerta Visagara, Gate of Madrid, Toledo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate arched gateway with detailed engravings. It features a large, arched gateway within a stone structure. Above the arch is a detailed emblem with a double-headed eagle and scrollwork. The drawing includes faceless figures in the foreground and midground, with some on foot and one on horseback. The stonework is textured and elaborate, capturing the architecture's grandeur. The lighting and shading create depth, drawing the viewer's eyes through the gateway. Shadows from the arch enhance the composition's drama.

artworks.title: Lower Broadway
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a busy urban street lined with tall buildings. The architecture is detailed with intricate lines, giving it a textured appearance. The scene is monochrome in black and white, emphasizing the detailed linework. People and vehicles fill the street, and the buildings create a canyon-like effect.

artworks.title: The Stock Exchange
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a busy urban street scene. The viewpoint looks down a city avenue surrounded by tall buildings. The horizon is not visible due to the tall structures. The etching technique shows intricate details of the architecture with sharp lines. The color palette is monochromatic with blacks and beiges. The street is crowded with small figures of people, and the buildings show elaborate facades and windows as they extend into the distance.

artworks.title: The Golden Cornice, I
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view of a cityscape with detailed buildings on both sides. The horizon is not clearly visible, and the street extends into the distance with smaller buildings in diminishing perspective. The artistic style features meticulous etching with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and shadow. The color palette includes shades of black and grey on a pale background, emphasizing architectural details. A streetcar or trolley is seen among pedestrians, bringing life to the scene, while the buildings and architectural elements are the main focus as they recede into the background.

artworks.title: Forty-Second Street
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing an urban scene with a bustling street surrounded by buildings. The street converges towards a vanishing point in the distance. The etching has a sketch-like style with fine lines and stippling. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. There are multi-storey buildings and an elevated rail structure in the background, with pedestrians and carriages in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Portico, British Museum
artworks.description: The image is a black and white artwork depicting a view framed by two large classical columns. The columns are detailed and shadowed, leading our gaze towards buildings in the background. A figure walks towards the distant view, with a sketch-like style focusing on line details and textures. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting contrasts and textures.
